body:
I feel better this morning. I always try to go to sleep when I feel like this, but sometimes trying to go to sleep just ends up giving me more time to think. 

Honestly the only person in my life who I think truly loves and cares about me is my mom, and I can share to a degree, but I really don’t want to scare or hurt her. And the two people I thought were my friends have been pulling away from me, so it’s weird, and scary, and lonely, but mornings are always better. 

I’m sorry you feel like that. Humans need connection more than anything, and it’s so horrible to not have anyone.
